items.title: Start of Unterhaltsvorschuss (advance maintenance) payments
items.quote: für Ihre Tochter Marie zahlen wir ab dem 01.11.2026 Unterhaltsvorschuss nach dem Unterhaltsvorschussgesetz in Höhe von 293,00 € monatlich.
items.computation: The letter states the benefit is paid starting from 01.11.2026, a fixed calendar date given explicitly in the text.

items.title: File Widerspruch (objection) against the benefit decision
items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids bei uns eingehen (Kreisverwaltung Musterhunsrück, Schlossplatz 7, 55469 Musterbach im Hunsrück)
items.computation: The letter itself states its own Zugangsfiktion: 'Ein Bescheid, den wir per Post versenden, gilt am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben.' Assuming Aufgabe zur Post = the letter's date 19.11.2026 (Thursday), the fourth day after is 23.11.2026 (Monday) — this is the deemed Bekanntgabe (delivery) date, and it is not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday so no shift is needed. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (analogous application to administrative deadlines), the day of Bekanntgabe itself is not counted, so the one-month Widerspruchsfrist begins on 24.11.2026. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, a period of one month ends with the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event (23), i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). This day is a regular weekday in Rheinland-Pfalz (not a public holiday), so no further shift under § 193 BGB is required. The Widerspruch must reach the Kreisverwaltung by this date.

items.title: Immediately report if the father pays maintenance or if you move
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns bitte sofort mit, wenn er Unterhalt an Sie zahlt oder Sie umziehen.
items.computation: The letter requires immediate ('sofort') notification of two possible future events (maintenance payment by the father, or a change of address) without giving a fixed calendar deadline; since no triggering date has yet occurred, no exact due date can be computed.

warnings: The letter's stated postal-delivery fiction ('gilt am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben') uses four days, whereas the standard rule in § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X normally uses the third day after posting; the Widerspruch deadline above follows the wording actually printed in this letter, but if the authority applies the standard three-day rule instead the deadline could in fact be one day earlier (22.12.2026) — worth double-checking.

The exact date the letter was actually handed to the post ('Aufgabe zur Post') is not separately stated; it was assumed to equal the printed document date (19.11.2026), which is the usual but not certain practice.
